authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.57 and 20.4.58
scope: LTYPE_CONTROL 0x5 and standard LTYPE records BYBLOCK 0x14, BYLAYER 0x15 and CONTINUOUS 0x16 in the locally generated AC1012 collision pair.
checks: Both control frames bind one role-2 CONTINUOUS entry followed by hard-owned BYBLOCK and BYLAYER. The three source frames bind exact names, description, zero dash count and pattern, all 256 zero text-area bytes, relative control owners, null extension and xref, boundaries and padding.

Each wrong-role mutation and byte-prefix truncation is rejected by the shared-bit observer, followed by successful original-frame retry. The adapter's source-bound linetype membership rejects a changed row owner, then passes after correction; the two source controls and shared vector CTest pass.

Independent cadkit-dwg 0.5.4 decodes the selected CONTINUOUS name, description, zero-dash body and the LTYPE_CONTROL's counted and two extra identities. The peer labels R13 untested. The updated handoff packet includes all four frame hashes. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: The generated frames place BYBLOCK before BYLAYER, while the specification lists the names in the other order. This observation does not establish a universal slot order; the adapter checks the identities of both slots without assuming one.
Only selected zero-dash generated R13 records are checked. Complete graph closure, AutoCAD normal-open, cloning semantics, native output and general support remain unqualified.
